This compound is predicted to interact with 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1, which is known to be a target of Etofenamate. Etofenamate, in turn, is predicted to interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The final score of 0.5509 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the compound may play a role in the transport of anionic molecules, possibly through interactions with the receptor or its downstream effects. The evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where the compound may influence the activity of the transporter, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm this interaction.
